why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check that you're eligible. Arcus isn't available in the United States, Canada or the United Kingdom, and users must be 18 or older.
Bridge a little ETH to Robinhood Chain for gas, open app.arcus.xyz and connect a wallet. Spot trading needs no invite.
For perpetuals, get an invite code from an existing trader and deposit USDG. Traders earn one code for every $1 million of perpetuals volume.
Trade, then check your weekly allocation on the points dashboard .
costs: Spot Stock Token trades carry no Arcus fee, though you pay gas in ETH. On perpetuals, the entry tier pays a 0.0225% taker fee and no maker fee during the beta. The Arcus help center page on perpetual fee tiers on 18 October 2026, with the taker rate for each tier. Source: Arcus help center Warning The larger cost is market risk: perpetuals charge hourly funding, and a leveraged position can be liq
risks: The US, Canada, the UK and sanctioned regions are restricted, and the terms prohibit using a VPN to get around the block. Arcus allocates points at its sole discretion and can reduce or cancel them, including retroactively. Wash trading, self-matching, rapid deposit and withdrawal cycles and hedged farming can cut your points to zero. Points can't be transferred or sold.
